name: infographic
title_zh: 文章丢给它，吐回一张能发朋友圈的高清信息图
tagline_zh: 公众号长文、推特长 thread、随便一段笔记，都能变成一张竖版高 DPI 信息图。不用排版、不用找模板。
tagline_en: Long reads, tweet threads, or random notes become a vertical high-DPI infographic. No layout, no templates—just.
desc_en: Generate professional infographic images from articles, tweets, or any structured content. Use this skill when the user asks to create an infographic, visual summary, knowledge card, or sharable image from an article or topic. Also triggers on: "生成信息图", "做张图", "总结成图片", "visual summary", "knowledge card", "shareable image for WeChat/social media". Produces high-DPI PNG images optimized for mobile v
why_zh: 不是把文字塞进现成模板，而是先解析内容结构，再按移动端阅读习惯重排视觉层级。出图即终稿。
why_en: It doesn't force text into a template—it parses structure, then rebuilds visual hierarchy for mobile reading. Output is final.
limit_zh: 只吃结构化或半结构化文本（文章、推文、列表）；纯扫描 PDF 或手写笔记需先转文字。产物是 PNG 图。
limit_en: Only accepts structured/semi-structured text (articles, tweets, lists). Scanned PDFs or handwriting need OCR first. Output is PNG only—no editable.
title_en: Turn articles into share-ready HD infographics
